literal: Xue Chu; Jing Xianjun; Ping Jian
idiomatic: Xue Chu; Jing Xianjun; Ping Jian

literal: Xue Chu, styled Tanzhen, was a native of Henan.
idiomatic: Xue Chu, styled Tanzhen, came from Henan.

literal: His ancestors for generations had been Dai people; their original surname was the Chigan clan.
idiomatic: His forebears for generations had been Dai people; the clan had originally borne the surname Chigan.

literal: His father Biaozi was Wei inspector of Xu Province.
idiomatic: His father Biaozi had been Wei inspector of Xu Province.

literal: Chu was tall and imposing of bearing; from youth he was known for competence and usefulness.
idiomatic: Chu was tall and imposing; from youth he was known for competence and resolve.

literal: As director of guests for audiences, whenever he received visitors his bearing and presence were striking.
idiomatic: As director of guests for audiences, whenever he received visitors his bearing and presence were striking.

literal: The Wei emperor summoned him and said, "Your bearing is stern and composed, your appearance outstanding; you will rise in rank — what office do you desire?
idiomatic: The Wei emperor summoned him and said, "Your bearing is stern and composed, your appearance outstanding; you will rise in rank — what office do you desire?

literal: " Chu said, "In the rites of the ancestral temples I dare not be disrespectful; in the affairs of court I dare not be disloyal — beyond that, a mediocre minister cannot presume."
idiomatic: " Chu said, "In the rites of the ancestral temples I dare not be disrespectful; in the affairs of court I dare not be disloyal — beyond that, a mediocre minister cannot presume."

literal: In the Zhenguang era he acted as magistrate of Luoyang; within his district all was orderly.
idiomatic: In the Zhenguang era he acted as magistrate of Luoyang; within his district all was orderly.

literal: When anyone violated the law, without resort to torture he pursued the matter through reasoning and cross-examination, and in most cases got at the truth.
idiomatic: When anyone broke the law he did not resort to beating; he pursued the matter through argument and cross-examination alone, and in most cases got at the truth.

literal: The powerful and unruly feared his authority; affairs became simple and quiet.
idiomatic: The powerful and unruly feared his authority; affairs grew simple and quiet.

literal: At that time, because of prolonged drought, all prisoners held in the capital were gathered at Hualin to review wrongs and delays; in Luoyang's jails only three remained.
idiomatic: At that time, because of long drought, all prisoners held in the capital were gathered at Hualin to review wrongs and delays; in Luoyang's jails only three remained.

literal: Emperor Xiaoming of Wei praised him and bestowed a hundred bolts of silk.
idiomatic: Emperor Xiaoming of Wei praised him and bestowed a hundred bolts of silk.

literal: He was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel. Minister Cui Liang memorialized to establish the "halt by years" rule, not screening for talent but asking only seniority and prior service.
idiomatic: He was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel. Minister Cui Liang memorialized to establish the rule of halting by years of service, not screening for talent but asking only seniority and prior service.

literal: Chu submitted a memorial saying, "The lives of the people depend on their chief officials. If the right man is found, revival and rest have a place; if the wrong man holds office, the harm goes deeper.
idiomatic: Chu submitted a memorial saying, "The lives of the people depend on their chief officials. If the right man is found, revival and rest have a place; if the wrong man holds office, the harm goes deeper.

literal: If the selection office takes only years of service and does not distinguish worthy from unworthy, then in principle it is like geese flying in rank or fish strung on a line — one clerk with the register calling names would suffice; what need is there for several men and the scales of appointment?
idiomatic: If the selection office takes only years of service and does not distinguish worthy from unworthy, then in principle it is like geese flying in rank or fish strung on a line — one clerk with the register calling names would suffice; what need is there for several men and the scales of appointment?

literal: I ask that this not be followed."
idiomatic: I ask that this not be followed."

literal: The memorial was submitted but received no response.
idiomatic: The memorial was submitted but received no response.

literal: Later, on being summoned for audience, he again remonstrated, saying, "Governing the realm together is fundamentally the charge of all the hundred offices.
idiomatic: Later, on being summoned for audience, he again remonstrated, saying, "Governing the realm together is fundamentally the charge of all the hundred offices.

literal: Therefore the Han often ordered the three excellencies and great ministers to recommend men of worth and integrity, upright and learned, men who speak directly of the Way, to serve as chief officials overseeing and comforting the people.
idiomatic: Therefore the Han often ordered the three excellencies and great ministers to recommend men of worth and integrity, upright and learned, men who speak directly of the Way, to serve as chief officials overseeing and comforting the people.

literal: Since the end of Jin that custom has fallen away.
idiomatic: Since the end of Jin that custom has fallen away.

literal: Now the four quarters are newly settled; the task is to nurture the people.
idiomatic: Now the four quarters are newly settled; the task is to nurture the people.

literal: Your servant asks that following the Han we again establish the four categories, requiring the three excellencies and noble ministers each to recommend men of the time to fill commanderies and counties, with clear regulations to guard against the beginnings of faction.
idiomatic: Your servant asks that following the Han we again establish the four categories, requiring the three excellencies and noble ministers each to recommend men of the time to fill commanderies and counties, with clear regulations to guard against the beginnings of faction.

literal: " An edict was sent down for the excellencies and ministers to discuss; the matter likewise lapsed.
idiomatic: " An edict was sent down for the excellencies and ministers to discuss; the matter likewise lapsed.

literal: When Yuan Tianmu campaigned against Xing Gao, Chu was made mobile headquarters minister of the masters of writing.
idiomatic: When Yuan Tianmu campaigned against Xing Gao, Chu was made mobile headquarters minister of the masters of writing.

literal: At that time Yuan Hao already held Zan City.
idiomatic: At that time Yuan Hao already held Zan City.

literal: Tianmu gathered civil and military officers to discuss which foe to strike first.
idiomatic: Tianmu gathered civil and military officers to discuss which foe to strike first.

literal: Those in council all said Xing's forces were very strong and should be dealt with first.
idiomatic: Those in council all said Xing's forces were very strong and should be dealt with first.

literal: Chu held that Xing Gao had gathered a crowd without legitimate cause; however strong, he was still a bandit;
idiomatic: Chu held that Xing Gao had gathered a crowd without legitimate cause; however strong, he was still a bandit;

literal: Yuan Hao was kin close to the imperial house; coming in the name of a righteous rising, his intentions were hard to read.
idiomatic: Yuan Hao was kin close to the imperial house; coming in the name of a righteous rising, his intentions were hard to read.

literal: Xing was a rat thief and dog pilferer, with no far-reaching ambition; Hao should be attacked first.
idiomatic: Xing was a rat thief and dog pilferer, with no far-reaching ambition; Hao should be attacked first.

literal: Tianmu, yielding to what the assembly wanted, attacked Xing first.
idiomatic: Tianmu, yielding to what the assembly wanted, attacked Xing first.

literal: When Xing surrendered the army returned — and Hao then entered Luoyang.
idiomatic: When Xing surrendered the army returned — and Hao then entered Luoyang.

literal: Tianmu said to Chu, "I did not heed your counsel, and it has come to this."
idiomatic: Tianmu said to Chu, "I did not heed your counsel, and it has come to this."

literal: Early in Tianping, the Grand Ancestor brought him in as chief administrator of the chancellor's office.
idiomatic: Early in Tianping, Gao Huan brought him in as chief administrator of the chancellor's office.

literal: Chu had long been known for ability and was treated with great courtesy; he was consulted on many matters of army and state.
idiomatic: Chu had long been known for ability and was treated with great courtesy; he was consulted on many matters of army and state.

literal: Chu likewise gave loyal service with full devotion and repeatedly offered forthright remonstrance.
idiomatic: Chu likewise gave loyal service with full devotion and repeatedly offered forthright remonstrance.

literal: The Grand Ancestor launched a great western campaign and was about to cross the Pu ford.
idiomatic: Gao Huan launched a great western campaign and was about to cross the Pu ford.

literal: Chu remonstrated, saying, "The western rebels have suffered famine year after year; they have nothing to eat. That is why they risk death to enter Shaan Province — to seize grain from the granaries.
idiomatic: Chu remonstrated, saying, "The western rebels have suffered famine year after year; they have nothing to eat. That is why they risk death to enter Shaan Province — to seize grain from the granaries.

literal: Now Minister Gao has already invested Tong Pass; the grain cannot get out.
idiomatic: Now Minister Gao has already invested Tong Pass; the grain cannot get out.

literal: Simply place troops on the roads and do not fight in the open field. By next year's wheat harvest the people will all have starved; Bao Ju and Hei Hu will surrender of themselves.
idiomatic: Simply place troops on the roads and do not fight in the open field. By next year's wheat harvest the people will all have starved; Bao Ju and Hei Hu will surrender of themselves.

literal: I beg Your Highness not to cross the river."
idiomatic: I beg Your Highness not to cross the river."

literal: Hou Jing also said, "This expedition's forces are immense; if by any chance we do not prevail, they will be hard to gather in again.
idiomatic: Hou Jing also said, "This expedition's forces are immense; if by any chance we do not prevail, they will be hard to gather in again.

literal: Better to divide into two armies and advance in succession: if the vanguard wins, the rear joins its strength; if the vanguard falls, the rear takes up the fight."
idiomatic: Better to divide into two armies and advance in succession: if the vanguard wins, the rear joins its strength; if the vanguard falls, the rear takes up the fight."

literal: The Grand Ancestor accepted neither counsel, and thus came the defeat at Shawei.
idiomatic: Gao Huan accepted neither counsel, and thus came the defeat at Shawei.

literal: He rose in repeated promotions to vice director of the masters of writing and died.
idiomatic: He rose in repeated promotions to vice director of the masters of writing and died.

literal: On his deathbed he charged his sons to lay him out in seasonable dress, bury him after a single month, and not solicit posthumous office by importuning.
idiomatic: On his deathbed he charged his sons to lay him out in seasonable dress, bury him after a single month, and not solicit posthumous office by importuning.

literal: He himself made his funeral carriage without carving or ornament, using only hemp for tassels and net cord for ropes.
idiomatic: He himself made his funeral carriage without carving or ornament, using only hemp for tassels and net cord for ropes.

literal: He forbade altogether the setting out of spirit objects and the like.
idiomatic: He forbade altogether the setting out of spirit objects and the like.

literal: Chu had long served within the imperial secretariat; he was versed and clear in ledgers and registers, and in judgments at his post he was swift as flowing water.
idiomatic: Chu had long served within the imperial secretariat; he was versed and clear in ledgers and registers, and in judgments at his post he was swift as flowing water.
